basic_info.name: SUT-Crack
basic_info.description: SUT-Crack segmentation dataset containing 130 asphalt pavement images (3024x4032) with pixel-level binary crack masks captured on Hashemieh Boulevard, Mashhad, Iran.

imaging_setup.camera: Samsung Galaxy S20 FE smartphone (7.3 x 5.4 mm sensor, 5.4 mm lens) mounted on a vehicle's rear bumper
imaging_setup.lighting_conditions: Includes varied lighting, shadows, and oil-stain conditions

annotation_schema.description: Pixel-wise crack mask annotations from the SUT-Crack source release.

geographic_coverage.temporal_scope: Published in 2023 (Mendeley Data v6, 2023-09-18); captured on Hashemieh Boulevard, Mashhad, Iran

quality_assurance.annotation_quality: Pixel-level binary crack masks (3024x4032) paired with 130 parent asphalt pavement images in the Mendeley Data v6 release (119 of 130 JPEG files carry EXIF orientation tag 6 to match the 3024x4032 portrait mask dimensions).
